key_insight: dSpark accelerates diffusion language models by learning when to reveal tokens that make other positions easier to predict, rather than prioritizing only easy tokens.
engineering_relevance: Learned token-commitment schedules can reduce decoding rounds and enable faster parallel generation for mathematical reasoning and code tasks.
method: Construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal reduces uncertainty at other positions.
Distill these schedules into the model for faster parallel sampling.
Use KL-divergence regularization to help preserve generation quality.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluations on math reasoning and code generation, with GSM8K speedups of 10.12× for LLaDA-8B-Instruct and 5.12× for Dream-7B-Instruct over baselines while maintaining superior task performance.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify timing conditions or schedule-construction costs, so deployment speedups and training overhead require verification.
paper_title: Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models
